question: The __ __ is known as the Great or Inner Himalayas or the Himadri.

options.text: longitudinal valley lying between the lesser Himalaya and the Shiwaliks

solution:

• The Great Himalayas, also known as the Inner Himalayas or Himadri, is the northernmost and highest range of the Himalayas
